about: Values the Locus Lead prototype report shows, read from the engine's committed outputs by tools/locus_leads_prototype_extract.py (opengwas/opengwasdb-stores#444).

method.ranking: abs_z descending, then Store Variant Index ascending

map.interpolation: linear between map points; flat beyond a chromosome's ends; NaN off the map

definitions.spurious_split: a Locus Lead that plink2 places inside a stronger index variant's clump
definitions.lost_signal: a plink2 index variant that the rule merges into a stronger Locus Lead

per_lead_criteria.clearly_better_measure: disagreement rate = (spurious splits + lost signals) / (Locus Leads + index variants), per Analysis and pooled

count_criteria.C1: rank. Spearman rho(Locus Leads, r2 0.01 index variants) over the swept Analyses is >= 0.95.
count_criteria.C2: density. For each swept Analysis, restrict the shared set to HapMap3 variants and recompute the leads at every (D, W) and bp-only; no re-clumping. Density ratio = leads(HM3) / leads(full). C2 holds when the median ratio over Analyses is in [0.8, 1.25] and its median |log2| is at most half that of the same ratio for raw row counts (rows(HM3) / rows(full)).
count_criteria.C3: cM against bp-only, at the same W. cM adds value when its best D improves on bp-only by at least 0.01 in rho (C1) or by at least 0.1 in median |log2 density ratio| (C2), without being worse on the other by more than those margins.
count_criteria.c3_reading: at a W, C3 holds when some D improves on that W's bp-only by at least one margin and is worse on neither by more than its margin; the D that do are listed.
count_criteria.named: the (D, W), bp-only included, that meets C1 and C2 and has the smallest pooled share of leads lost to density, sum over Analyses of max(0, leads(full) - leads(HM3)) / sum of leads(full); the best cM point is named the same way.
count_criteria.index_variants: plink2 at r2 0.01, on the same shared set as the leads

ancestries.chance_what: chance LD at each panel's own sample size: the share of unlinked (cross-chromosome) variant pairs reaching an r^2, over the panel variants the swept Analyses share, both drawn with a fixed seed

parameters.budget: pruning runs per query when its stages cost no more than the query they follow (fast_ratio <= 1), so the reader waits at most twice as long

slices.name: mvp_5e-8
slices.why: a Dense Reference-Completed tier an eighth the size

slices.name: height_5e-8
slices.why: a Hybrid tier most of whose rows are imputed

slices.name: observed_only_5e-8
slices.why: the largest Observed-Only tier: no imputed rows at all
